capability.summary: Estimate nationality probabilities for a name
capability.description: Queries Nationalize.io with one required name parameter. The response is a probabilistic demographic estimate, not a verified identity attribute. HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
capability.problem_space: Aggregate name-to-nationality probability estimation; not identity verification, ethnicity classification, or person profiling.

constraint.io_signature: Input: name at CLI position 1. Output: shared JSON envelope with url, http_status, and Nationalize result. HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
constraint.output_shape: HTTP 2xx/3xx: {status: "success", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}. HTTP 4xx/5xx: {status: "error", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}, exit 1. Request exception: {status: "error", tool: string, message: string}, exit 1.
limitations: probabilities are model estimates from aggregate data and do not establish a person's nationality
no age, gender, identity, confidence threshold, pagination, or batch input
wrapper does not locally truncate or interpret the country probability list; no auth, cache, or retry

output_contract.description: Shared JSON envelope containing Nationalize name count and country probability estimates, URL, and HTTP status.

intent_tags: estimate nationality probabilities from a name
negative_intents: infer sensitive identity attributes about an individual

output_contract.description: Shared JSON envelope containing Nationalize name count and country probability estimates, URL, and HTTP status.
